comment: Convergence W0-3 (R4, owner decision 94): Cloud's contracts export no name Rovara Code's contracts also export, EXCEPT the exact names listed here (per file). Every entry says why, in one of three kinds: `owedUntil` (Cloud is ahead of Code; a Code lane is landing the shape, and the entry fails CI after that date), `cloudOnly: true` (Cloud's own on purpose; never expires) or `migration: true` (a shape in saved data; adopting it is a data migration, so it never expires on its own and is listed in DEFERRED-CHECKS). tests/contract/cloud-contracts-no-duplicate-names.test.ts checks: a name both packages export must be listed under the file that defines it; a listed name must still be shadowed (take it off when Code catches up); an owed entry past owedUntil fails. Importers take a name both define from @agentx/cloud-contracts.

files.reason: Cloud's deploy-role, boundary and operator policies (custom domain, ECR/Cognito/Resolver service-linked roles, team-record storage, CloudFront, AppSync) are AWS infrastructure that Code's reduced public cut does not and should not carry. Infra output must not change.

The health alarm lists name Cloud's own CloudWatch alarms (the team-record and lessons alarms, conditional suffixes), and AdminHealthResponse carries Cloud's teamRecordCheck and slack/github rows; Code's plugins[] health rows (H3) are adopted by the wave 1 adapter, not by sharing this schema.
Decision 78 (retireConfirm, retire_confirm and retire_keep) is in Cloud only.

The project summary names the project's meta repository (`metaRepository`, additive, lane srv/needs-broker-ui batch 1), and the detail and every answer that carries the summary or the detail (list, archive, setup check, settings) follow it. Code's summary does not have the field yet, and a Code schema would strip it from the answer; the Code lane that adds it lets these entries go. Same text as Code's apart from that one field.

Cloud's approval-place.ts is the byte copy of Code lane commit 062f50bbf (decision 99: a rejection and a request for changes are judged like a medium approval). Public code/next at the pin 0e340c0e has the older file (PR #451, a reject is browser-only), so the copy stays until that lane lands in public code/next and the pin moves (tests/contract/approval-place-upstream-copy.test.ts).

AuditActor is the audit ledger's actor ({ kind: member | operator | system | github }), a stored record shape of Cloud's own ledger; Code's AuditSink port actor ({ type: person | agent | system }) is mapped by the wave 1 audit adapter.
Cloud's catalog trust adds the staging-only key list and the build flavor, which belong to Cloud's own build (Code carries only CATALOG_TRUSTED_SIGNING_KEYS).

Decision 70(c) workflow shapes (the re-run of the checks after a merge of the base, its daily allowance, the base-merged block and auto-fix codes) are in Cloud only. OrgSettingName and orgSettingsKey: Cloud holds more company setting names (budgets, spend policy, task stop, local agents) than Code's three.
OrgRoleSchema carries the Enterprise auditor role; Code's is owner, admin, member (D10).

ProjectDefinitionSchema refuses a saved repository host: the release before this one reads a project strictly, so writing a host would take a rollback dark (tests/contract/repository-host.test.ts). Code lifted that rule (C2 writes hosts) and adds externalChecks (C5) and the host provider; adoption is a migration with P2-EXTERNAL-CHECKS-CLOUD-ADOPTION.

Collaborator project role (W11, A-23/A-26, owner answer Q8): Code's ProjectRoleSchema is maintainer, contributor, viewer. Cloud adds `collaborator` and two permissions (answer_questions, approve_product_decisions), and the people routes must name a collaborator. Everything outside collaborator paths keeps Code's three roles with the collaborator's floor (viewer, projectRoleFloor); the collaborator row equals the viewer row on every Code permission (tests/contract/collaborator-role.test.ts). A Code lane adds the role, then this entry goes.

WorkerInvocationSchema embeds the workflow shapes above, and WORKER_INVOCATION_FEATURES lists the company image feature task.testServices.companyImage.v1 (decision 65: a worker protocol change goes to the owner). Two Code port lanes are building it (fix/code-base-merged-recheck, fix/code-owed-small).
bootStage2Sha256 (the worker's boot stage 2 hash check) belongs to Cloud's EC2 worker boot.

Cloud's RealtimeNotice is the closed union of the events API's wire notices (session.updated, session.event, home.changed, device.command), inferred from RealtimeNoticeSchema; Code's RealtimeNotice (ports/realtime.ts) is the port's open type-and-ids shape. Same name, different things; a Cloud realtime adapter maps one to the other.

MERGE_NOT_READY_MESSAGES has the behind-by-hand and base-merged lines (decision 70(c)); WorkflowFixPayload and WorkflowBranchSync carry Cloud's 40-hex commit id where Code's C4 takes any hash length. Two Code port lanes are building it (fix/code-base-merged-recheck, fix/code-owed-small).
MergeTrackingItem keeps approval.githubUserId in stored merge records; Code writes hostUserId. Adopting needs a dual read and a migration first (DEFERRED-CHECKS: CONVERGENCE-W0-3-CONTRACTS).

A company-approved image's mirror repository (`rovara-env/<env>/o<org>/c<image>`, company-images-worker, 0.5.15) is accepted beside a saved environment's repository: the repository name checks, the session policies, the repository policy (the mirror's own role) and the login, prepare and use shapes. Code's text only knows the saved environment's name. SavedEnvRegistryAuthSchema here is the hosted one (the cloud registry's host and the user AWS only), so the loopback registry of Code's laptop adapter is refused where Cloud reads a login. The other new names in this file (isCompanyImageRepositoryName, companyImageMirror*, COMPANY_IMAGE_MIRROR_ACTIONS, companyImageRepositoriesArn) are Cloud's only.
SAVED_ENV_FIXED_KEY_GLOBS lists the Brazil Config file; it is part of every saved environment's key, so changing it would rebuild every environment.
The lessons permission (decision 46b) is in Cloud only.
